items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1961-06-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] No. The ones that I know came up under us was...

ctx.x: I worked at the main office about six years and after that I was transferred to the Margaret Place branch, Camp and Calio. After the bridge came in there and they had to destroy that branch then we built up a new branch on St. Charles and the Radicals, the St. Charles branch. That's the main one, right? No, that's two branches. You see the Margaret Place branch was on Camp and Calio. And the same, that was the same branch that moved over to the new place on St. Charles Street. But the main office, I started at…

And all. Well, all I think of it. I wanted to ask just what part of town you were born in and where you were raised. I was born on Mandible between Charles and Spain. Oh way down there. Yeah. You see Papa Lane. Do you remember Jack Lane by any chance? The white drummer who had a lot of bands and other bands.
I was born on Mandible between Charles and Spain. Oh way down there. Yeah.
